messages:
elaine: I opened a small PR to add an 'offline HSM + proxy' quickstart to the private deploy docs. Covers PKCS#11 URIs, minimal proxy firewall examples (nftables + iptables), and a short verification checklist. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4301
doc-bot: Auto-check: docs linter passed, linkcheck found 1 moved anchor.
mike: Quick asks: 1) include a one-line Windows alternative for customers using Windows bastion, 2) add 2 one-liners for PKCS#11 usage so customers can paste into proxy config.
elaine: For Windows I'll add a netsh portproxy example. For PKCS#11 candidates: "pkcs11:token=acme;object=bastion-key" and "pkcs11:slot-id=1;object=server-cert". Also a note about label vs id differences.
security: Add a mandatory security blurb: "Verify GPG signatures and SHA256 checksums for all offline artifacts before installation. Do not skip verification in air-gapped sites." Keep it single sentence.
mike: Also include a tiny troubleshooting checklist (3 bullets): tcpdump/tshark to confirm ClientHello SNI, curl --resolve to force DNS, and check proxy TLS logs for ALPN/handshake errors.
elaine: Will add those and shorten the proxy config section to remain a quickstart. Pushing update now.
ops-bot: CI for PR #4301 44d linkcheck: fixed, all checks passed.
mike: LGTM, merging. Thanks!
